text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Aoba Sho, Zenno Rob Roy 
thinks of heroes heading into battle, 
shivering with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"To become a hero." With unyielding 
resolve, she headed toward the race.
